hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 16 GiB unified memory, macOS 26.3 arm64, CPU only (no GPU used by v6)
external_resources: dataset-v1 public archive and evaluator revision 65b98e480f2a10b82f974f4feb519ee4e012d66c; supplied local drawings are required at inference
v6 uses no pretrained or external weights; both models were trained on the public training split only. No external training dataset was added.
Inference uses local model files and original drawing assets and does not fetch annotations or weights

Public validation was scored for v1-v3, so the v6 score is validation-informed; no v6 setting was selected on public validation. Stage-2 settings came from document-grouped fit cross-validation; the color gate and threshold 0.14 came from the 55-query development split. Freeze: artifacts/frozen-pipeline-v6.json.
peak_memory_mb uses decimal MB of measured peak memory footprint; the inference run had 0 swaps. Runtime covers the whole Python process; scoring and packaging are excluded.
time_spent_hours was last captured for v2 and must be recomputed at publication.

Model files are expected at models/models/texture-hgb-crop-v1.joblib and research_v5/stacker/cache/stage2_model.joblib relative to the repository root; this layout should be simplified before publication.
v2 (artifacts/validation-v2) is preserved as a fallback; v6 improves IoU, recall and precision over v2 but the 95% IoU and 95% precision targets remain unmet.
